description: One slice of a scheduled run's work: how many units of it sit in one window, and which part of the window's time they occupy. A run longer than a window is SPLIT, and each slice is one of these — so a "3 h batch" over three one-hour windows reads as three slices of the same run instead of a run that magically appears three times. The record is a VALUE the planner and the host both produce; Units is what the window's capacity gives up.

members.name: Duration
members.description: How long the slice lasts, or Zero when it ends before it starts.

members.name: EffectiveUnits
members.description: The units the slice actually covers: never below zero.

members.name: Start
members.description: When the slice starts, in the host's timeline.

members.name: Units
members.description: How many units of the run this slice covers. A negative value reads as zero.

members.name: WindowId
members.description: The id of the window the slice sits in.
